I loved this show even as I was frustrated by it. I was fully immersed even as my mind sidetracked to wonder at the hows and whys.

cn.t: Critics hail Snook's virtuoso, technically dazzling one-woman performance across 26 characters as stunning and audacious, though a few find the multimedia spectacle exhausting or gimmicky. The innovative adaptation wins widespread praise for its relevance and sheer theatricality.
